content.name: Military Saddle
entries: A military saddle braces the rider, helping you keep your seat on an active mount in battle. It gives you advantage on any check you make to remain mounted.

content.name: Military Saddle
entries: A saddle comes with a bit, a bridle, reins, and any other equipment needed to use the saddle. A Military Saddle gives {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on any ability check you make to remain mounted.
